execution: Existing ARM64 Ubuntu20.04 task container; network interfaces {}; non-root checker UID1001; standalone inputs outside proof-producing workspace. No Mathlib build or production checker changes.
official: Replay.lean imports retained compiled Export.Parse, prints raw parsed type/value, replays the one-definition map in a fresh empty kernel environment at trust0.
nanoda: One thread, no axioms permitted, selected declaration pretty-printed to stdout, completion count required.
demand: Compare actual official parser output exactly to cases.json before treating its verdict as qualified. Nanoda raw constructors are source-bound and both checkers consume byte-identical files verified before and after execution. No runtime branch-coverage instrumentation: I2 tests preserved imax and equivalent max operand; no claim of forcing a particular imax case-split branch.
controls: Six positive source-derived expectations in three equivalent pairs. No intentionally invalid declaration, known fault, negative-control detection rate or independent holdout. M1/M2 require nonidentical symbolic max conversion; I1/I2 require Pi universe inference with parameter-right imax. Future negative controls require a separately selected item.
process_controls: Outer supervised matrix300s; each guest timeout120s with kill-after10s; supervisor host-client memory4GiB, sample1s,maxgap5s,cleanup10s, outputcap20MiB. Existing container memory12GiB,cpu4,pids512,no-new-privileges; VM RAM~7.7GiB. Controls are nonterminal; diagnose/repair any failures without altering the frozen six cases. HostCLI RSS is not guest checker memory.
preparation_repair: importer-preflight Lake tried dependency URL reconciliation and was denied write permission, before any scientific check. importer-preflight-r2 uses lean directly with the compiled parser LEAN_PATH; pass. No dependency fetched or changed.
